verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents multiple official SDK/API surfaces for building integrations: the Storage Write API (gRPC) client, a Rust SDK now in Preview, ODBC/JDBC drivers, the Python-based bq CLI, and a machine-readable REST v2 discovery document verified reachable keylessly at runtime. This gives an AI-native builder concrete, documented, and runtime-verified official surfaces to build against. Missing for 10: explicit listing/mention of mainstream language client libraries (Python, Java, Node.js, Go, .NET) by name and any independent hands-on developer report confirming SDK ergonomics beyond docs.
